author: reek
body: The PSI values chosen are deliberately NOT the defaults. A PORTSC speed of 7 answering Full-speed, 8 answering High-speed and 9 answering Low-speed is a mapping no default table contains, so a reader that ignores the PSI dwords and returns the raw value cannot pass: it would answer 7, 8 and 9, which are not speeds at all.
